texts.li: A party of {FACTION} has stopped {PLACE} and is pitching tents. They say they mean no harm and won't stay long.
Travelers of {FACTION} have made camp {PLACE}, and are unloading their packs as if they mean to stay a while.

li.label: Let them stay
li.outcome: Word goes out that they can stay. The camp {PLACE} will be there a while.

outcomes.li: [trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} walks out with a pot of something hot and tells them they're welcome. They will camp {PLACE} for a while.
[winter] The colony lets them be, and in this cold they look glad of it. They'll be camped {PLACE} a while yet.

li.label: Let them stay, on terms
li.outcome: They may stay, on terms the colony will set.

outcomes.li: [skill:Social] {A_nameDef} will go out and talk terms with them. They seem ready to listen.

li.label: Ask them to move on, with {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: They take the silver with thanks and go.

outcomes.li: They count the silver, thank {A_nameDef} twice, and start packing.

li.label: Ask them to move on
li.outcome: They take it badly, but they go.

outcomes.li: They grumble about the colony's manners all through the packing, but they go.

li.label: Drive them off
li.outcome: The strangers are told to be off the colony's land, now, and what will happen if they aren't. They pack in a hurry.

outcomes.li: The strangers don't wait to argue. They're gone within the hour, and their fire is still burning.

li.label: the walk out to the camp

texts.li: {COUNT} fighters of {FACTION} have come over the hill at a run, weapons out. {X_nameDef}, at their head, shouted to {A_nameDef} that they have no quarrel with the colony: it's {ENEMY} they've come for, and they'll fight them wherever they find them. They ask only that the colony's people don't shoot at theirs.

[oldfoe] Word of {ENEMY} on the colony's land reached {FACTION}, who have an old score with them. {COUNT} of their fighters have arrived, {X_nameDef} leading, and mean to settle it here and now, beside the colony's own.

[mechs] {COUNT} fighters of {FACTION} came in on the colony's side of the fight: nobody loves the machines, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, and a chance to break some where someone else holds the walls is a chance worth a day's march.

[their:friend] {FACTION} remember a friend among the colony's people. When word came that the colony was under attack by {ENEMY}, {COUNT} of their fighters set out at once; {X_nameDef} says they'll hold the colony's flank for as long as it takes.

li.label: Welcome them: fight together
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} waved them in. The fighters of {FACTION} are going after {ENEMY} alongside the colony's own.

outcomes.li: [trait:Brave] {A_nameDef} ran out to meet them and pointed the way to the fight. The fighters of {FACTION} are at it beside the colony's own.

li.label: Ask them to hold at the edge
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} shrugged and drew {X_possessive} people up at the edge of the map. They'll defend themselves if it comes to them, and no more.

li.label: Send them away
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} stared at {A_nameDef} a long moment, then turned {X_possessive} people round. {FACTION} will remember the welcome.
